summary_md: **poseidanai ([@poseidanai](https://x.com/poseidanai/status/2115245683305247115))** shares **awesome-opus5-5-videos**, a collection of 703 viral Claude Opus 5.5 videos with the exact prompts behind them; each is generated as code rather than by a video model, so prompts can be pasted into Claude Code.

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - yihui-dev/awesome-opus5-5-videos: A growing collection of viral videos made with Claude Opus 5.5 and the prompts behind them. Watch each original next to a live remake on Skillry. Updated regularly.

relevance: A large prompt corpus for code-generated video, useful as reference material.

media.description: Mosaic grid of roughly a hundred small screenshots of different 3D web games and scenes (racing, space, platformers, puzzle) on a dark background.
